title: Bond yields surge to fresh two-decade highs but oil prices buffeted by Iran headlines - NBC News
description: Key U.S. Treasury yields surged to fresh two-decade highs Thursday, as the price of oil returned to $105 per barrel.

title: Senate rejects resolution calling to end the Iran war, as most Republicans stick with Trump - NBC News
description: The Senate voted to direct President Donald Trump to end the U.S. war with Iran, after several Republicans defected and voted with Democrats.

title: Nearly 170,000 pounds of raw meat recalled for false inspection labels - The Washington Post
description: The affected products were produced before Sept. 22 and may have false USDA inspection labels that say “EST. 1363.”
